snippet.title: Cozywood Creek | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Cozywood Creek is a gentle idle game that quietly lives at the bottom of your screen. While you work, study, or unwind, a small creek flows peacefully - always present, never demanding attention.A comforting companion, while you're doing what you need to.



Shape Your River Bend!

Transform your creek environment through decoration and terraforming. Start with simple riverbanks and gradually shape the land into anything from sandy beaches and driftwood shores to bushy forests, mossy stones, and leafy undergrowth. 



Watch a Natural Ecosystem Grow

As you develop the environment, animals begin to appear naturally. Birds find places to perch, frogs settle near the water, and woodland creatures make themselves at home in the habitats you create!



Calm, Idle Progression

Cozywood Creek is designed to unfold slowly. There are no timers to race and no constant tasks pulling at your attention. Progress happens gently over time, rewarding patience, observation, and creative choices to decorate your screen!



Cozy Atmosphere & Ambient Motion

Subtle animations, flowing water, and peaceful scenery bring the creek to life without overwhelming your screen. Cozywood Creek adds warmth and atmosphere to your desktop, creating a small, living world you can enjoy at a glance.
